notes.title: Cat Save System Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there, cat lovers! 🐱

Good news! With this update, the game will now remember how many kitties you've found — so next time you hop back in, you can continue right where you left off🐾

Have fun! 🎉

notes.title: Maya: Cats of Istanbul is Launch!
notes.notes:
Meow People,

Maya: Cats Of Istanbul game is launch today!

3 different cute, iconic, dioramas of Istanbul ... 300 cats including the famous cats of Istanbul Gli and Tombili are waiting for you.

We hope it will be a relaxing and fun experience.

Thank you in advance to everyone who bought the game :)

Greetings from Maya :)

notes.title: Maya: Cats of Istanbul wishlist now on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45377966/efe272ed90f395e1c0cae934fc237ed410ddc0fc.png[/img]

Maya: Cats of Istanbul wishlist is now on Steam.

Greetings from Istanbul, the capital of cats.

As a cat lover, I didn't forget cats while designing a game for the first time :) I designed a great game for both HOG and cat lovers. A cat finding game that takes place in the historical and famous districts of Istanbul.

Our game includes famous Istanbul places such as Galata Tower, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace. We find lost cats in these places.

Forget all the HOGs you know, this will be a little difficult for you :)
Finding well-hidden cats in detailed mixed models requires good HOG experience, patience and a good eye :D

I wish you all a lot of fun in this game that I named after my cat MAYA and will keep her eternal memory alive. I wish you a long life Maya!

A portion of the game revenues will also be used for the feeding, shelter and health expenses of the street cats of Istanbul.

This way Maya will help her friends on her own behalf, it's exciting to think about it :)

I will also share videos of me going to the areas in the game and feeding the cats there on the youtube channel in the link below.

Have fun everyone :)

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkuU08XM1oL__DJcxGjiXyQ]Youtube[/url]

Greetings from Maya :)
